caption: The drawing consists of two views of a wooden mechanical device placed on a cream-colored background. The top view shows the device from an external perspective: it is a rectangular box made of brown wood with a hand crank handle attached to a gear on the right side, and two metal latch mechanisms securing a hinged lid on the front. On top of the box, there is a small, rectangular metallic tray. The bottom view shows the same device with its lid open, revealing the internal mechanism. Inside, there is a cylindrical drum with regularly spaced pegs or spikes arranged diagonally, situated between two parallel rows of evenly spaced pointed blades. The crank handle is visible on the right and the construction of the box, including its legs and side panels, is visible. The device primarily consists of light to medium brown tones with some metallic gray detailing on the tray and hardware. There is a handwritten note and scale at the bottom right of the image.
title: Meat Grinder
